spec.model: alpha_t=f(complete rolling window of L OHLC candles), nonnegative, same function for both cases; arithmetic mean across all complete windows fromSTART toEND.
spec.generous_quantization: UnderlyingC may be within observedC +/-1second, covering nearest/floor/ceil to integer.
spec.necessary_condition: Window sequenceA consists of oneextra window then sequenceB. Hence mA*mean(alphaA)-mB*mean(alphaB)=alpha_extra>=0.
spec.scope: Rejects this fixed-window arithmetic-mean coefficient family only. Not recursive/adaptive weights depending on priorstate, different initialization windows, nonlinear aggregation, or arbitrarydirectC formulas.
